resources.name: CausalBench K562/RPE1
resources.reason: Only K562 and RPE1 are independent biological contexts, below the registered minimum of three and insufficient for train, development and unseen-context transfer.

resources.name: sci-Plex 3
resources.reason: The screen has exactly three cancer cell lines. Holding out one leaves only two source contexts, so it cannot support three genuine source-context scales without row or well subsampling; no published unseen-intervention split repairs that limitation.

resources.name: Tahoe-100M
reasons_to_retain: The public raw-count table uses one stable integer gene-token coordinate system across cell lines.
The publication reports 47 sufficiently covered cell lines, 379 drugs, 1135 drug-dose combinations and 52886 cell-line-drug-dose conditions after QC, plus plate-matched DMSO controls.
Context-count scales and unseen cell-line/drug partitions can in principle be frozen from identifiers before outcomes, without pathways, gene ontology, drug targets or mechanism labels.
The pinned public repository reports CC0-1.0, content-addressed files and a measurable 429 GB full acquisition boundary; streaming is documented.
unresolved_before_migration: Verify the complete pinned file manifest and content digests rather than relying on a mutable repository label.
Read metadata only to measure the cell-line by drug-dose coverage, DMSO availability and replicate counts before freezing outcome-blind train, development and test partitions.
Show that three declared context scales use whole source contexts and fit within local acquisition, disk, memory and compute budgets; row subsampling is forbidden as a substitute.

Specify one anonymous raw-count interface and source-identical PCA, nearest-neighbor, adaptive/probabilistic and intervention-aware controls without curated MOA, targets, tissue, driver mutations or semantic gene enrichment.
